scripts.text: You know... this place doesn't seem to be safe for you. Please return to me once you have achieved ^0000FFLevel 99^000000 or higher.
scripts.translation: 你知道吗...这里似乎不适合你。等级达到^0000FF99级^000000或以上后再来找我。

scripts.text: I am not sure you have fully explored the crack in space and time yet. Perhaps you should look a bit further into it.
scripts.translation: 我不确定你是否已经充分探索了时空裂缝。或许你应该再深入调查一下。

scripts.text: What did you see in there?!
Hrumph, Sara Irene?! She's one of the 12 Valkyries. I didn't know her story was that tragic...
scripts.translation: 哼，莎拉·艾琳？！她可是12位女武神之一。没想到她的故事如此悲惨...

scripts.text: It seems that you caused a huge misunderstanding between her and her father.
scripts.translation: 看来是你在她和父亲之间造成了巨大的误会。

scripts.text: You should not blame yourself for what occurred, or all the blood that was spilled. It seems that the events that day were fated to happen no matter who was there.
scripts.translation: 别为发生的一切或流下的鲜血自责。看来无论当时是谁在场，那天的事都是命中注定的。

scripts.text: Please don't tell anyone about your time travelling adventure. We can't have anyone thinking you more important than old Leon. Plus they wouldn't believe such a story anyway.
scripts.translation: 别把你的时空旅行冒险告诉别人。可不能让人以为你比老里昂还厉害。而且这种故事也没人会信。

scripts.text: I think in about 20 hours after you last entered the rift, it will be stable enough for you to transverse it again.
scripts.translation: 我想你上次进入裂缝约20小时后，它就会稳定下来，可以再次穿越了。

scripts.text: I think in about 20 hours after you last entered the rift, it will be stable enough for you to transverse it again.
scripts.translation: 我想你上次进入裂缝约20小时后，它就会稳定下来，可以再次穿越了。

scripts.text: ^0000FF[ Sara's Memories ] Cooldown has been cleared. It is now possible to use the dimensional device again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF[莎拉的回忆]冷却时间已结束，现在可以再次使用次元装置。^000000

scripts.text: You wish to relive the past again?
Please venture through the dimensional device and report to me what you find within.
scripts.translation: 请通过次元装置探索一番，再把里面的情况告诉我。

scripts.text: Though I should warn you. It might be unstable. Make sure you enter as soon as you can.
scripts.translation: 不过先提醒你，装置可能不太稳定。准备好后尽快进去。

scripts.text: Well... I can't force you. But if you ever find the courage please talk to me again.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我不能勉强你。但如果你鼓起勇气了，记得再来找我。

scripts.text: I am not sure you have fully explored the crack in space and time yet. Perhaps you should look a bit further into it.
scripts.translation: 我不确定你是否已经充分探索了时空裂缝。或许你应该再深入调查一下。

scripts.text: ^0000FF[ Sara's Memories ] Cooldown has been cleared. It is now possible to use the dimensional device again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF[莎拉的回忆]冷却时间已结束，现在可以再次使用次元装置。^000000

scripts.text: I am not sure you have fully explored the crack in space and time yet. Perhaps you should look a bit further into it.
scripts.translation: 我不确定你是否已经充分探索了时空裂缝。或许你应该再深入调查一下。

scripts.text: I am glad to hear that! Maybe someday you can be as brave as old Leon the Lion!
scripts.translation: 听你这么说我很高兴！也许有一天你能像老狮子里昂一样勇敢！

scripts.text: Well... I can't force you. But if you ever find the courage please talk to me again.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我不能勉强你。但如果你鼓起勇气了，记得再来找我。

scripts.text: What did you see in there?!
Hrumph, Sara Irene?! She's one of the 12 Valkyries. I didn't know her story was that tragic...
scripts.translation: 哼，莎拉·艾琳？！她可是12位女武神之一。没想到她的故事如此悲惨...

scripts.text: It seems that you caused a huge misunderstanding between her and her father.
scripts.translation: 看来是你在她和父亲之间造成了巨大的误会。

scripts.text: You should not blame yourself for what occurred, or all the blood that was spilled. It seems that the events that day were fated to happen no matter who was there.
scripts.translation: 别为发生的一切或流下的鲜血自责。看来无论当时是谁在场，那天的事都是命中注定的。

scripts.text: Please don't tell anyone about your time travelling adventure. We can't have anyone thinking you more important than old Leon. Plus they wouldn't believe such a story anyway.
scripts.translation: 别把你的时空旅行冒险告诉别人。可不能让人以为你比老里昂还厉害。而且这种故事也没人会信。

scripts.text: I think in about 20 hours after you last entered the rift, it will be stable enough for you to transverse it again.
scripts.translation: 我想你上次进入裂缝约20小时后，它就会稳定下来，可以再次穿越了。

scripts.text: Excuse my rudeness! I am Pon de Leon, the famous adventurer!
scripts.translation: 请原谅我的失礼！我就是大名鼎鼎的冒险家庞·德·里昂！

scripts.text: My friends call me Leon the Lion! For my tough appearance and attitude. Plus I have quite the bite!
scripts.translation: 朋友们都叫我“狮子里昂”！因为我外表和性格都很强悍，而且咬合力也很惊人！

scripts.text: You know, this is such a strange location...
scripts.translation: 你知道吗，这地方真奇怪...

scripts.text: As you explore it you start to see cracks in space and time. Each one covered by a dimensional device.
scripts.translation: 探索这里时，你会发现一道道时空裂缝，每道裂缝都被一台次元装置覆盖着。

scripts.text: For example, I think I have caught glimpses of Payon through the one closest to us. But it doesn't seem right. Almost like it is a little bit older than it should be.
scripts.translation: 比如，我好像透过最近的那道裂缝看到了斐扬。但感觉不太对劲，那里似乎比现在的斐扬更古老一些。

scripts.text: I want to explore it, but with my old age and my knees I don't seem to be quite up to the task.
scripts.translation: 我很想进去探索，可惜年纪大了，膝盖也不听使唤，恐怕做不到。

scripts.text: So, I would like to ask something of you.
scripts.translation: 所以，我想拜托你一件事。

scripts.text: Please venture through the dimensional device and report to me what you find within.
scripts.translation: 请通过次元装置探索一番，再把里面的情况告诉我。

scripts.text: Though; I should warn you. It might be unstable. Make sure you enter as soon as you can.
scripts.translation: 不过先提醒你，装置可能不太稳定。准备好后尽快进去。

scripts.text: Hey! You are too young to be playing with that! Come back when you are at least ^0000FFLevel 99^000000!
scripts.translation: 喂！你还太小，不能乱动那个！至少达到^0000FF99级^000000再来！

scripts.text: Before you go playing around with that; Why don't you come over here and talk to me?
scripts.translation: 别急着去摆弄那个，先过来和我聊聊吧？

scripts.text: Before you enter you need to organize a party! Don't you know how? Type /organize PARTYNAMEHERE.
scripts.translation: 进入之前必须先组建队伍！不会操作吗？输入/organize 队伍名称即可。

scripts.text: ^FF0000The dimensional device boots up cleanly. Use the device to enter the crack in space and time.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000次元装置启动正常。使用装置进入时空裂缝。^000000

scripts.text: The memorial dungeon {0} does not exist.
The party leader did not generate the dungeon yet.
Only the registered members can enter the instance {0}.
scripts.translation: 只有已登记的成员才能进入副本{0}。

scripts.text: ^FF0000The party leader did not boot up the dimensional device.^000000
I think in about 20 hours after you last entered the rift, it will be stable enough for you to transverse it again.
scripts.translation: 我想你上次进入裂缝约20小时后，它就会稳定下来，可以再次穿越了。

scripts.text: ^0000FF[ Sara's Memories ] Cooldown has been cleared. It is now possible to use the dimensional device again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF[莎拉的回忆]冷却时间已结束，现在可以再次使用次元装置。^000000

scripts.text: Hello! This is the village of Payon. You don't seem to be from around here...
scripts.translation: 你好！这里是斐扬村。你看起来不像是本地人...

scripts.text: Are you from here? You don't seem to quite match the locals either.
scripts.translation: 你是这里的人吗？看起来也不太像本地人。

scripts.text: Yes! I was born here! My name is Sara, Sara Irene!
scripts.translation: 没错！我在这里出生！我叫莎拉，莎拉·艾琳！

scripts.text: My father is doyen of this village! I just take after my mother.
scripts.translation: 我爸爸是村里的长老！我只是长得像妈妈。

scripts.text: Oh! I am sorry! Uh... Why are you standing out here all alone?
scripts.translation: 啊！抱歉！呃...你为什么一个人站在这里？

scripts.text: I am waiting for my father. He said that he will be here soon.
scripts.translation: 我在等爸爸。他说很快就会来。

scripts.text: ^FF0000An older man exits the house. Sara's face brightens at the sight of him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000一位年长的男子从屋里走出来。莎拉一看到他，脸上立刻露出笑容。^000000

scripts.text: You said you would come back soon! I waited for you and you lied!
scripts.translation: 你说很快就回来！我等了你好久，你骗人！

scripts.text: Sweetheart, I am sorry I made you wait so long. The meeting with the village elders took longer than expected.
scripts.translation: 宝贝，对不起，让你等这么久。和村里长老的会议比预想的要久。

scripts.text: Don't say that sweetheart... Who is this with you?
scripts.translation: 别这么说，宝贝...这位是谁？

scripts.text: ^FF0000Doyen Irene stares at you with fire in his eyes.^000000
^FF0000Sara starts humming and singing softly to herself. She picks some wild flowers nearby and presents them to the Doyen.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000莎拉轻轻哼唱起来，摘下附近的野花，递给长老。^000000

scripts.text: Oh Sara, may I have them?
scripts.translation: 哦，莎拉，这是送给我的吗？

scripts.text: ^FF0000After being given the flowers the Doyen's mood seems to greatly improve.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000收到花后，长老的心情似乎好了许多。^000000

scripts.text: Alright my princess, where should we go now?
scripts.translation: 好了，我的小公主，接下来想去哪儿？

scripts.text: Oh daddy! Lets go to the top of that hill over there!
scripts.translation: 爸爸！我们去那边山坡上吧！

scripts.text: Hah! Ok, hold onto me tight!
^FF0000As they wander off you hear strange voices from around the corner...^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000他们走远后，你听见拐角处传来奇怪的声音...^000000

scripts.text: I can feel Sara's power growing. We cannot just stand by and let her achieve her full potential!
scripts.translation: 我能感觉到莎拉的力量正在增强。不能袖手旁观，任由她发挥全部潜力！

scripts.text: She was born under a bad sign and her mother isn't even one of us!
scripts.translation: 她出生时就有不祥之兆，而且她母亲也不是我们族人！

scripts.text: Someday she will cause blood to flow in our streets.
scripts.translation: 总有一天，她会让我们的街道血流成河。

scripts.text: We have to do something before the Holy creatures select her. I asked 'HIM' to take care of it.
scripts.translation: 在神圣生物选中她之前，我们必须采取行动。我已经请“他”去处理了。

scripts.text: We will see... I look forward to hearing the bad news that has befallen her...
scripts.translation: 走着瞧吧...我很期待听到她遭遇不幸的消息...

scripts.text: ^FF0000The old men wander off. It seems Sara might be in danger. We have to do something!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000老人们离开了。莎拉似乎有危险，我们必须做点什么！^000000

scripts.text: Oh! Hello again! I remember you, what's up?
scripts.translation: 啊！又见面了！我记得你，有什么事吗？

scripts.text: I am here to give flowers to my mommy!
^FF0000Sara leaps forward to open the door, flowers at the ready.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000莎拉捧着花，迫不及待地跑上前开门。^000000

scripts.text: Mom! Dad! Look what I found!
scripts.translation: 妈妈！爸爸！快看我找到了什么！

scripts.text: ^FF0000The door opens to reveal a woman near death laying on the floor and the Doyen standing over the woman with a bloody sword.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000门开了，濒死的女人倒在地上，长老站在她身旁，手中的剑沾满鲜血。^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000A gem rolls from the woman's hand and comes to a rest in front of Sara. Unconsciously Sara reaches down and picks up the gem.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000一颗宝石从女人手中滚落，停在莎拉脚边。莎拉不由自主地弯腰捡起宝石。^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000The Doyen turns around and notices Sara.^000000
Ahh Sara! I was just looking for you...
Guards! GUARDS!! There is a murderer here! Catch him!
scripts.translation: 卫兵！卫兵！！这里有杀人犯！抓住他！

scripts.text: ^FF0000The sound of many pairs of boots can be heard running outside!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000屋外传来一阵急促的脚步声！^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000Sara runs away and the sound of the guards is getting closer...^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000莎拉逃走了，卫兵的脚步声越来越近...^000000

scripts.text: I have been looking for you Sara. Please come with daddy, it is very dangerous here!
scripts.translation: 我一直在找你，莎拉。快跟爸爸走，这里很危险！

scripts.text: I won't let you take Sara!
The murderer is here! Guards! We will finish him once and for all!
scripts.translation: 杀人犯在这里！卫兵！这次一定要解决掉他！

scripts.text: You... were too strong for me.
scripts.translation: 你...太强了，我不是你的对手。

scripts.text: Why... *hack* are you trying to kill my wife and daughter?
scripts.translation: 为什么...*咳*你要杀我的妻子和女儿？

scripts.text: What are you talking about? We saw you standing over Sara's mother with your sword COVERED in blood!
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？我们亲眼看到你站在莎拉母亲身边，剑上全是血！

scripts.text: You... think I killed Sara's mother?
scripts.translation: 你...以为是我杀了莎拉的母亲？

scripts.text: She *cough* had already been stabbed by an assassin. I slew him *hack* that is why my blade was covered in blood...
scripts.translation: 她...*咳*早就被刺客刺伤了。我杀了刺客...*咳*所以剑上才会沾满鲜血...

scripts.text: ^FF0000Thinking back, you seem to recall another body laying in the left corner of the room. Maybe that was the assassin the Doyen is talking about.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000仔细回想，房间左边角落似乎还躺着一具尸体。也许就是元老所说的刺客。^000000

scripts.text: If... you are the not the assassin sent to kill my wife and daughter, who are you?
scripts.translation: 如果...你不是被派来杀我妻女的刺客，那你是谁？

scripts.text: I am just an adventurer who was passing through. I heard some strange men plotting their deaths and needed to intervene.
scripts.translation: 我只是路过的冒险者。我听到一些怪人在策划杀害她们，所以出手阻止了他们。

scripts.text: If... you are telling the truth... forgive me. I thought you were one of them.
scripts.translation: 如果...你说的是真的...请原谅我。我还以为你是他们的人。

scripts.text: Strange men? ...I bet they were some of the village elders. Ugh...
scripts.translation: 怪人？...我猜他们是村里的长老。唉...

scripts.text: There might be more assassins so we have to find Sara as fast as we can!
scripts.translation: 可能还有更多刺客，我们必须尽快找到莎拉！

scripts.text: Sara believes that you killed her mother. We need to tell her the truth!
scripts.translation: 莎拉以为你杀了她母亲。我们得告诉她真相！

scripts.text: We must do our best to find her. Lets split up and search for her. Please help me find my daughter and explain everything to her.
scripts.translation: 我们必须尽全力找到她。分头去找吧。请帮我找到女儿，并向她解释清楚。

scripts.text: ^FF0000As you are about to call out to Sara, a sudden blow knocks you down from behind.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000你正要呼唤莎拉，突然从背后遭到重击，倒在地上。^000000

scripts.text: The time travellers cannot interfere any longer. You cannot stop us from meeting Sara.
scripts.translation: 时空旅人不能再继续干涉了。你阻止不了我们与莎拉见面。

scripts.text: You should go back to the time where you belong.
scripts.translation: 你该回到属于自己的时代了。

scripts.text: ^FF0000As you fall to the ground, two dark figures approach Sara.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000你倒地时，两个黑影朝莎拉走去。^000000

scripts.text: A girl full of betrayal, despair, and hate. We will guide you to your ultimate fate.
scripts.translation: 充满背叛、绝望与憎恨的女孩。我们会引领你走向最终的命运。

scripts.text: Sara Irene, 'he' will make your dreams come true.
scripts.translation: 莎拉·艾琳，“他”会实现你的愿望。

scripts.text: ^FF0000One of the cloaked strangers covers Sara with their cloak and all three figures disappear.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000其中一个披着斗篷的陌生人用斗篷裹住莎拉，三道身影随即消失。^000000
